verdict.rationale: cfo.ai is a SaaS product, so a downloadable API spec is a fair question. However, every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404, and the docs describe only an MCP server and an llms.txt docs index. Neither is a downloadable machine-readable API specification, so they are adjacent at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
